# Claude Code Settings: MCP and Channels

These keys decide which MCP servers and channels Claude Code may use.
Administrators use them to allow or block servers.
For example, `{ "enableAllProjectMcpServers": true }` approves every server in a project `.mcp.json` file.

The marks and the scopes are explained on [Settings](Claude-Code-Settings).
A `-` in the `Default` column means that neither the docs nor the schema state a default.

| Mark | Key | Type | Default | What It Is For | Scope | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `allowAllClaudeAiMcps` | boolean | - | Load the claude.ai connectors Claude Code fetches itself alongside a deployed `managed-mcp.json`. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` | boolean | - | Let the built-in Claude in Chrome server run alongside a deployed `managed-mcp.json`. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `allowedChannelPlugins` | array | - | Replace the default allowlist of channel plugins that can push messages. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `allowedMcpServers` | array | - | Allowlist which MCP servers users can add. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `allowManagedMcpServersOnly` | boolean | - | Make the managed MCP allowlist the only one that applies. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `channelsEnabled` | boolean | - | Allow channels for your organization. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `deniedMcpServers` | array | - | Block specific MCP servers by URL, command, or name. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `disableClaudeAiConnectors` | boolean | - | Turn off claude.ai connectors so Claude Code doesn't fetch them. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `disabledMcpjsonServers` | array of string | - | Reject specific servers from a project's `.mcp.json`. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `enableAllProjectMcpServers` | boolean | - | Approve every server in project `.mcp.json` files without a prompt. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `enabledMcpjsonServers` | array of string | - | Approve specific servers from a project's `.mcp.json`. | Any file | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `managedMcpServers` | object | - | Provide remote MCP servers to every user alongside the ones they add. | Managed | [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
